text: Billing flags installation INST-04821: an August total close to double its own twelve-month average. The easy move is to blame the hardware -- this lesson checks instead.
Raw S3 data for the installation looks completely normal -- about 8,924 readings at the expected cadence. Whatever's wrong, it isn't the inverter.
inverter_events_clean for the same scope has 9,003 rows against only 8,924 distinct event_id values -- 79 duplicate rows in a table whose entire job is removing duplicates.
Grouping by the one field guaranteed unique on every raw record finds the same reading sitting in the clean table twice, and those 79 rows account for almost exactly the billing gap.
The dedup step ran and still let this through. Next: reading its actual code to find out exactly why.
